minutes.headline: Planning Board approved a golf course land swap and a third driveway at 40 Pioneer Drive.
minutes.summary: The board approved an ANR plan swapping land between the Settlers Crossing golf course and an abutting owner. It closed the public hearing and approved a modified site plan restoring a third driveway at 40 Pioneer Drive. It heard committee and director reports, went through the draft zoning bylaw changes (marijuana, Summer Street use table) headed for Town Meeting, and moved the March 12 meeting to March 19 because of caucus night.

what_happened.line: The board approved an ANR plan swapping land between the Settlers Crossing golf course parcel and an abutting owner.
The board closed the public hearing for 40 Pioneer Drive and approved a modified site plan restoring a third driveway.
The approval carries over all original conditions except the hydrant condition and the existing-driveway condition.
The board went through draft zoning bylaw changes for Town Meeting, including marijuana and the Summer Street use table, with no resolution reached.
The board voted to move the March 12 meeting to March 19 because of caucus night.

why_it_matters: The zoning bylaw changes on marijuana and Summer Street uses would go to Town Meeting as articles, so residents will be asked to vote on what land uses are allowed.
Stormwater cost estimates are meant to feed capital budgeting, and a Green Communities grant round with a March deadline could shift street light upgrade costs off the town budget, mostly taxes.
